authority: Owner directive, 2026-08-11 evening (the same directive recorded in config/pd_planning_os.v002.json and docs/PD_EDITORIAL_DIRECTION.v002.md).
what_this_is: Roughly 200 title-shaped hypotheses, grouped by the series they belong to. They are NOT approved episodes and NOT verified facts. Each is a hypothesis about a premise that may exist; the named amounts, people and outcomes are placeholders until primary sources say otherwise.
how_to_use: 1. A seed is an entry to the funnel, not an exit from it. Scout finds the real case behind the seed.
2. State the contradiction in one sentence before writing any title (config/pd_planning_os.v002.json -> generators.contradiction).
4. Then run the producibility gate -- measure the shelf's register inventory before greenlight.
5. Check saturation: known demand x low saturation beats a higher score with ten competing videos.
warning: Any seed containing a figure, a name or an outcome is a guess written to show the SHAPE of the title. Never carry a number from this file into a script. See integrity.absolute in the planning OS.
